verdict.rationale: Codex ships a browsable catalog. In the CLI, `/plugins` opens a plugin browser for installing from configured marketplaces, and ChatGPT/Codex share a Plugins tab and one universal plugin directory where public plugins are discoverable. The official marketplace.json lists plugins with categories, and the openai/plugins GitHub repo enumerates available plugins. Curated skills can be installed by name via `$skill-installer`. Missing for 10: explicit search or filter functionality within the browser (only browsing is documented), a documented way to browse the curated-skills catalog before installing rather than installing by name, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the browsing experience.
